# First unified development engine release candidate

This experimental major release combines governance and the TypeScript harness in one bundled
package. It adds eight independently controlled decision-layer consumers: test-quality advice,
focused code review, optional context selection, workflow recommendations, optional-check advice,
device diagnosis, completion-claim advice and output selection.

All consumers default off. Missing JEV credentials preserve ordinary operation. Shared SQLite
call/byte limits, bounded evidence, cancellation, native result preservation and local telemetry
support controlled evaluation. Advice does not dispatch workflows, skip required checks, recover
devices or accept work. Context/output selection affects optional presentation only.

## Deliberate adoption

Use the exact archive and schema-2 runtime lock attached here with Node >=24.16.0 <25. This RC
is not an automatic upgrade. Review custom hooks, host instructions, runtime generations, workflow
catalogs and device evidence integration before activating it. Existing Python/wheel owners remain
active until the host's deliberate transition. Legacy context decision calls require explicit task
scope; source sharing and consumer permissions remain opt-in. Diff review initially supports JS/TS.

## Qualification and limits

Local source qualification passed447 engine,72 continuity,4 release-tooling and468 legacy Python
tests, plus typecheck and installed-package/wheel proof. The release workflow independently repeats
source/package checks. Installed fixtures cover all eight consumers, fallback, concurrent spending,
original-output preservation and inactive staging. Provider responses in this proof are synthetic.

Operator-authorized RC publication precedes SDK adoption, fresh native host event verification,
RN iOS simulator qualification and live JEV measurement. No device readiness, model-quality gain,
token savings or complete all-platform support is claimed. Physical removal/reconnect testing is
deferred. Real-device follow-up remains part of adopter qualification.

Local evidence files establish consistency, not tamper-proof execution authentication. Budget
storage has a visible8MiB capacity cap and512active-scope limit; exhaustion falls back without
resetting spending. Safe long-volume compaction remains a follow-up before broader adoption.
